title: SynapSys Governed Object/Relationship Adapter Contract
description: Declared adapter contract for the input this compiler accepts. Stream A (Codex runtime/integration graph) is expected to return data conforming to this shape; until it returns, callers must supply either live-sourced data (evidence=LIVE_VERIFIED or LIVE_PARTIAL) or explicitly labelled fixtures (evidence=LABELLED_FIXTURE). The compiler fails closed on any relationship referencing an object id not present in objects, and on any object or view missing its required authority field.

view_id.description: Stable profile identifier, e.g. n8n_topology, odoo_app_menu_object.

snapshot.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the underlying data was read. Not used in structural determinism comparisons.

id.description: Stable ID. Must be unique within objects[]. Never regenerated between compiles of unchanged input.

authority.description: Who/what authorises this object's current state. Required — compiler fails closed if absent.

group.description: Optional layout/semantic grouping column. Objects sharing a group are laid out in the same column.

verb.description: The relationship's verb, rendered as the edge label.
